JESTER-POWER_UP.title: Power Up
JESTER-POWER_UP.description:
Add X random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]|} Powers from any character into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Play each of them.
JESTER-SMART_METRONOME.title: Smart Metronome
JESTER-SMART_METRONOME.description:
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]|} card from any character into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
If it costs 0, it gains [gold]Replay[/gold] 2.
Play that card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
JESTER-METRONOME.title: Smart Metronome
JESTER-METRONOME.description:
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]|} card from any character into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
The card is usually good.
Play that card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
JESTER-METRONOME_JESTER.title: Metronome
JESTER-METRONOME_JESTER.description:
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]|} card from any character into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Play that card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
JESTER-JESTER_BASIC.title: Hidden Attack
JESTER-JESTER_BASIC.description: After entering a Event room, [gold]Transform[/gold] this card into a random{IfUpgraded:show: non-[gold]Strike[/gold]|} [aqua]Basic Attack[/aqua].
JESTER-HAT_TRICK.title: Hat Trick
JESTER-RNG_CANNON.title: RNG Cannon
JESTER-RNG_CANNON.description:
Add 2 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]|} Attacks from any character into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Play both of them and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
JESTER-HAT_TRICK_EX.title: Hat Trick EX
JESTER-HAT_TRICK_EX.description:
Gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
[gold]Channel[/gold] {Orbs:diff()} [gold]Lightning[/gold].
Can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] any number of times.
JESTER-SPLIT_THE_ATOM.title: Split the Atom
JESTER-SPLIT_THE_ATOM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {Poison:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], reduce this card's cost by X {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
JESTER-STRIKE_JESTER.title: Strike
JESTER-JESTER_SKILL.title: Secret Skill
JESTER-JESTER_SKILL.description: After entering a Combat room, Choose 1 of 3 random non-[gold]Defend[/gold] [aqua]Basic Skills[/aqua] to [gold]Transform[/gold] this card into.
JESTER-DEFEND_JESTER.title: Defend
JESTER-MIMIC_JESTER.title: Mimic
JESTER-MIMIC_JESTER.description:
Add a random card from another player's [gold]Hand[/gold] into your [gold]Hand [/gold](or a [gold]Strike[/gold] if there is no playable cards).
Play that card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
JESTER-ALCHEMIZE_JESTER.title: Alchemize
JESTER-CALTROPS_JESTER.title: Caltrops
JESTER-CALTROPS_JESTER.description: Whenever you are attacked, deal {ThornsPower:diff()} damage back.
JESTER-CLASH_JESTER.title: Clash
JESTER-CLASH_JESTER.description: Can only be played if every card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is an Attack.\nDeal {Damage:diff()} damage.
JESTER-DISTRACTION_JESTER.title: Distraction
JESTER-DISTRACTION_JESTER.description: Add a random Skill into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
JESTER-DUAL_WIELD_JESTER.title: Dual Wield
JESTER-DUAL_WIELD_JESTER.description: Choose an Attack or Power card. Add {IfUpgraded:show:{Cards} copies|a copy} of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
JESTER-ENTRENCH_JESTER.title: Entrench
JESTER-EQUILIBRIUM_JESTER.title: Equilibrium
JESTER-HELLO_WORLD_JESTER.title: Hello World
JESTER-HELLO_WORLD_JESTER.description: At the start of your turn, add a random Common card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
JESTER-REBOUND_JESTER.title: Rebound
JESTER-REBOUND_JESTER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.\nPut the next card you play this turn on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
JESTER-OUTMANEUVER_JESTER.title: Outmaneuver
JESTER-RIP_AND_TEAR_JESTER.title: Rip and Tear
JESTER-RIP_AND_TEAR_JESTER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy twice.
JESTER-SCRAWL_JESTER.title: Scrawl
JESTER-SCRAWL_JESTER.description: Draw cards until your [gold]Hand[/gold] is full.
JESTER-SEEK_JESTER.title: Seek
JESTER-SEEK_JESTER.description: Put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
JESTER-SEEK_JESTER.selectionScreenPrompt: Select {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} to put in your Hand.
JESTER-STACK_JESTER.title: Stack
JESTER-STACK_JESTER.description: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: +{CalculationBase}|}.{InCombat:\n(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].)|}
JESTER-EXTRA_TURN_PSYCHIC.title: Extra Turn?
JESTER-EXTRA_TURN_PSYCHIC.description:
Take an extra turn after this one.
Skip your next turn.
JESTER-CHAOS_RAMPAGE.title: Chaos Rampage
JESTER-CHAOS_RAMPAGE.description:
Take an extra turn after this one.
Apply 1 [gold]Madness[/gold] to yourself
Take 1 damage whenever you play a card next turn.
JESTER-THROW_WEAPON.title: Throw Weapon
JESTER-THROW_WEAPON.description:
Exhaust a non-[gold]Strike[/gold] Basic Attack in your hand.
If a card was [gold]Exhausted[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add [gold]Craft Weapon[/gold] into your Hand.
JESTER-EXOTIC_FORM.title: Exotic Form
JESTER-EXOTIC_FORM.description: At the end of your turn, gain {ExoticFormPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each unique color played, until the end of your next turn.
JESTER-CONFUSION_CARD.title: Confusion
JESTER-CONFUSION_CARD.description:
Take 6 damage.
If this is in your Hand, it must be played before other cards.
JESTER-CRAFT_WEAPON.title: Craft Weapon
JESTER-CRAFT_WEAPON.description: Add [gold]Throw Weapon[/gold] and a random non-[gold]Strike[/gold] [aqua]Basic Attack[/aqua] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
JESTER-AUTOPILOT.title: Autopilot
JESTER-AUTOPILOT.description:
Take an extra turn after this one.
Vakku plays your next turn.
JESTER-CLEAVE_JESTER.title: Cleave
JESTER-FLESH_GOLEM.title: Flesh Golem
JESTER-FLESH_GOLEM.description:
You and ALL allies lose 7 HP.
[gold]Summon[/gold] equal to the HP lost.
JESTER-BLOOM.title: Bloom
JESTER-CHEERLEAD.title: Cheerlead
JESTER-CHEERLEAD.description:
Another player becomes [gold]The Alpha[/gold].
The first card [gold]The Alpha[/gold] plays each turn is played an extra time.
JESTER-SETUP_JESTER.title: Setup
JESTER-SETUP_JESTER.description: Put a card from your hand on top of your draw pile. It costs 0 until played.
JESTER-DIVINE_PROTECTION.title: Divine Protection
JESTER-DIVINE_PROTECTION.description:
Another player becomes [gold]The Alpha[/gold].
Prevent the next time [gold]The Alpha[/gold] would lose HP.
JESTER-CHOSEN_WARRIOR.title: Chosen Warrior
JESTER-CARNAGE.title: Carnage
JESTER-CLOTHESLINE.title: Clothesline
JESTER-GHOSTLY_ARMOR.title: Ghostly Armor
